    limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=500),
    offset: int = Query(0, ge=0),
    status: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status, Query
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from typing import List, Optional

from app.database import get_db
from app.models.tasks import Task
from app.schemas.task import TaskSchema
from app.utils.auth import get_current_user
from app.models.users import User

tasks_router = APIRouter()

@tasks_router.get("/tasks", response_model=List[TaskSchema])
def get_tasks(
    limit: int = Query(5, ge=1, le=500),
    offset: int = Query(0, ge=0),
    sort_by: Optional[str] = Query("created_at"),
    sort_order: Optional[str] = Query("desc"),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    """Retrieve a list of tasks for the current user with pagination and sorting."""
    query = db.query(Task).filter(Task.user_id == current_user.id)

    if sort_by:
        if sort_by not in Task.__table__.columns.keys():
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Invalid sort_by field: {sort_by}")

        if sort_order == "desc":
            query = query.order_by(getattr(Task, sort_by).desc())
        else:
            query = query.order_by(getattr(Task, sort_by).asc())

    tasks = query.offset(offset).limit(limit).all()
    return tasks

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional, Any

from app.database import get_db
from app.models.article import Article
from app.models.user import User
from app.utils.auth import get_current_user

article_router = APIRouter()


class ArticleCreate(BaseModel):
    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}
    title: str = Field(min_length=1)
    content: str = Field(min_length=1)


class ArticleResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}
    id: int
    title: str
    content: str
    author_id: int


@article_router.get("/articles", response_model=List[ArticleResponse])
def get_articles(
    author_id: Optional[int] = Query(None),
    limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=500),
    offset: int = Query(0, ge=0),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    query = db.query(Article)
    if author_id:
        query = query.filter(Article.author_id == author_id)
    articles = query.offset(offset).limit(limit).all()
    return articles


@article_router.post("/articles", response_model=ArticleResponse)
def create_article(
    article_in: ArticleCreate,
    current_user: Any = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    article = Article(
        title=article_in.title,
        content=article_in.content,
        author_id=current_user.id,
    )
    db.add(article)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(article)
    return article
